learningObjective: Realize that stacked ring-rectangles form a triangle with base 2πR and height R, whose area equals πR² — the circle area formula
ahaMoment: The sweep completes and the student sees the stacked bars form a triangle with base 2πR and height R, and the triangle area formula gives exactly πR²

miniSpec.title: Adding Ring Areas
miniSpec.manipulated_variable: Draggable slider controlling sweep position outward through the radii
miniSpec.primary_visual_feedback: Horizontal bars appear stacking upward, widening with r; currently added ring highlighted; formula 2πr×dr displayed above ring; running total counter showing accumulated area
miniSpec.goal_structure: Guided sweep from 0 to full radius R, with the payoff being the completed triangle and area equaling πR²
miniSpec.causal_chain_exposed: Current sweep position, the ring being added with formula 2πr×dr, running total of accumulated area, triangle dimensions (base 2πR, height R), final area ½ × 2πR × R = πR²
miniSpec.trace_strategy: All added bars remain visible, building up the triangle progressively — this accumulation IS the concept
miniSpec.aha_moment: The sweep completes and the student sees the stacked bars form a triangle with base 2πR and height R, and the triangle area formula gives exactly πR²

modelVariables.R: The circle radius (frozen, carried over from previous section)
modelVariables.numRings: Number of concentric rings (frozen, carried over from previous section)
modelVariables.sweepR: Current sweep position (0 to R), student-dragged
modelVariables.triangleEmerges_accumulatedArea: derived: sum of ring areas up to sweepR
modelVariables.triangleEmerges_currentRingArea: derived: area of the ring at current sweepR (2πr × dr)
modelVariables.triangleEmerges_triangleArea: derived: ½ × 2πR × R = πR² (the final formula result)

assertions.description: On load, the sweep starts at a low value so the triangle is incomplete, inviting the student to drag further
assertions.visualCheck: Triangle is partially formed with bars stacked, not yet complete

assertions.description: The slider control exists and can be operated to change sweep position
assertions.visualCheck: Dragging the slider changes the sweep position

assertions.description: As sweep increases, bars stack upward forming a triangle and area counter increases
assertions.visualCheck: More horizontal bars visible, triangle shape emerging, area counter increased

assertions.description: At full radius, the triangle is complete and area equals πR²
assertions.visualCheck: Complete triangle visible with base 2πR and height R labeled, area shows πR² ≈ 50.27

assertions.description: R and numRings are frozen/carried over and do not change during interaction
assertions.visualCheck: The circle radius R and number of rings remain constant and appear locked

invariants.description: Accumulated area is always between 0 and πR²
Sweep position stays within 0 to R
